photos.title: On usage of my photographs
photos.photoAlt: Panorama of City of London during The Shard’s opening laser show
photos.explanation: You must have landed on this page after spotting a link in one of my photos (e.g. on <flickr>Flickr</flickr>). If you are wondering about the usage terms, here are a few hints:

hints.license: Check if a page with the photograph contains a link to the origin or mentions the license. Most of my works are shared under <cc>Creative Commons</cc>, meaning that they are free even for commercial use.
hints.exif: If you hold a downloaded copy, look into EXIF data for the licence type.
hints.contact: If you would like to get a higher-resolution version, remove the watermark or use the photograph under specific terms, please <email>drop me a line via email</email>.
